profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, with reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the fiscal year ending September 27, 2025, and trades on public markets under the ticker AAPL. The company describes its core AI offering, Apple Intelligence, as helpful AI that is integrated into apps, grounded in user context, and private at every step, with a next-generation version planned for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The site describes Siri AI as a conversational assistant powered by Apple Intelligence that can answer questions, take actions in apps such as Messages, Music, and Reminders, generate or edit written content, automate tasks via Shortcuts, and identify real-world objects or on-screen content; it will launch in beta, initially in English, and will not be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, or watchOS at launch.

The site tracks Apple Intelligence as an on-device large language model using Private Cloud Compute and Apple silicon with a privacy-first design, alongside Final Cut Pro AI and iMovie AI, both of which emphasize on-device processing and Apple silicon optimization for video editing. Two MCP servers are registered in connection with Apple: one described as managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting in chat, and another described as providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients. No litigation is currently recorded against the company in the held facts.
